verdict.rationale: Jev is a typed-decision model API, so the automations themselves live in the user's own code. The only relevant evidence is model version control: versioned IDs, `jev-latest`/`jev-preview` aliases, guidance to pin a version and migrate on your own schedule, and a response field reporting which version answered. That lets you hold or revert the model behind an automation, but it does not version or roll back the automations. Missing for 10: versioning of saved questions/automations, review or diff workflow, rollback of automation definitions, change history, independent corroboration.
